title: WT - WhiteTnT
description: WT - WhiteTnT – If you're tired of the red TNT texture in Minecraft, I can totally recommend this.
body:
## WhiteTnT
— **_WhiteTnT_** – If you're tired of the classic red TNT texture in Minecraft, this pack is a nice change. It replaces the usual TNT with a clean white version that fits well with modern builds and different resource packs. It’s simple, but it makes TNT look a lot better in-game.
